```{r}
###############################################################################
# Are the PDO cultures free of immune and stromal cells?
#   Marker check in the 4 PDOs (BO-046, BO-114, BO-189, BO-268), with the pILC
#   tumors as a reference for what "present" looks like.
#
# MARKERS
#   Immune        PTPRC (CD45), CD3E (T cells), CD68 (macrophages)
#   Fibroblast    COL1A1, DCN, LUM
#   Endothelial   PECAM1
#   Epithelial    EPCAM, KRT8, KRT18  (positive control: should be HIGH in PDOs)
#
# WORKFLOW
#   1. Read PDO raw counts and tumor raw counts (4_Count_file_pILC)
#   2. CPM = counts / total counts of the sample x 1e6 (all genes in the
#      library size), then log2(CPM + 1)
#   3. Ensembl -> gene symbol; keep the marker genes only
#   4. Table: raw count, CPM and log2CPM per PDO and marker, with the tumor
#      median / range and the PDO value as a fraction of the tumor median
#   5. Figure: tumor boxplots per marker, PDOs as colored diamonds
#
# HOW TO READ THE RESULT (rules of thumb, not strict cutoffs)
#   - Immune / fibroblast / endothelial markers: very low raw counts and CPM
#     close to 0, far below the tumor median -> few or no such cells.
#   - Epithelial markers: high in PDOs -> the culture is made of tumor cells.
#   - One marker alone is not proof: tumor cells can express small amounts of
#     some stromal genes (e.g. DCN), so look at the whole panel.
#   - Bulk RNA-seq cannot give an exact percentage of contaminating cells.
#
# OUTPUT (folder: PDO; no dates in file names)
#   PDO_marker_check_values.csv
#   plots/PDO_marker_check.png / .pdf
###############################################################################

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  library(AnnotationDbi)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
})

SEED <- 42
set.seed(SEED)

# ------------------------------ 1. SETTINGS ----------------------------------
ROOT         <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq"
PDO_COUNTS   <- file.path(ROOT, "PDO", "PDO_raw_counts.csv")
COUNTS_DIR   <- file.path(ROOT, "4_Count_file_pILC")
CLUSTER_FILE <- file.path(ROOT, "NMF", "GenePattern_NMFConsensus",
                          "vst_transformed_data.consensus.k.3.gct")
OUT_DIR      <- file.path(ROOT, "PDO")
dir.create(file.path(OUT_DIR, "plots"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

markers <- data.frame(
  gene  = c("PTPRC", "CD3E", "CD68",
            "COL1A1", "DCN", "LUM",
            "PECAM1",
            "EPCAM", "KRT8", "KRT18"),
  group = c(rep("Immune", 3), rep("Fibroblast", 3),
            "Endothelial", rep("Epithelial (control)", 3)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
markers$group <- factor(markers$group,
                        levels = c("Immune", "Fibroblast", "Endothelial", "Epithelial (control)"))

strip_version <- function(x) sub("\\..*$", "", x)

# Marker CPM and raw counts from a raw count matrix (rows = Ensembl IDs)
marker_values <- function(count_mat) {
  lib  <- colSums(count_mat)                       # library size (all genes)
  ids  <- strip_version(rownames(count_mat))
  anno <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = unique(ids),
                                keytype = "ENSEMBL", columns = "SYMBOL")
  anno <- anno[!duplicated(anno$ENSEMBL), ]
  sym  <- anno$SYMBOL[match(ids, anno$ENSEMBL)]

  rows <- which(sym %in% markers$gene)
  sub  <- count_mat[rows, , drop = FALSE]
  s    <- sym[rows]
  # if a symbol has several Ensembl IDs, keep the one with the highest mean count
  ord  <- order(rowMeans(sub), decreasing = TRUE)
  sub  <- sub[ord, , drop = FALSE]; s <- s[ord]
  sub  <- sub[!duplicated(s), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(sub) <- s[!duplicated(s)]

  miss <- setdiff(markers$gene, rownames(sub))
  if (length(miss) > 0) warning("Markers not found: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))

  cpm <- t(t(sub) / lib) * 1e6
  list(counts = sub, cpm = cpm, lib = lib)
}

# ------------------------------ 2. PDOs --------------------------------------
pdo_raw <- read.csv(PDO_COUNTS, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
pdo <- as.matrix(pdo_raw[, setdiff(colnames(pdo_raw), "gene")])
rownames(pdo) <- pdo_raw$gene
mode(pdo) <- "numeric"
stopifnot(!anyNA(pdo))
pdo_vals <- marker_values(pdo)

# ------------------------------ 3. TUMORS (reference) ------------------------
clusters <- read.delim(CLUSTER_FILE, skip = 2, check.names = FALSE,
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
tumor_ids   <- clusters$Name
count_files <- list.files(COUNTS_DIR, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
file_key    <- sub("\\.txt$", "", basename(count_files))
cluster_key <- gsub("\\.", "-", sub("_S[0-9]+$", "", tumor_ids))
missing <- setdiff(cluster_key, file_key)
if (length(missing) > 0) stop("No count file found for: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
count_files <- count_files[match(cluster_key, file_key)]

read_one <- function(f) {
  x <- read.delim(f, header = FALSE, col.names = c("gene", "count"),
                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  x[grepl("^ENSG", x$gene), ]
}
count_list <- lapply(count_files, read_one)
stopifnot(all(sapply(count_list, function(x) identical(x$gene, count_list[[1]]$gene))))
tum <- sapply(count_list, function(x) x$count)
rownames(tum) <- count_list[[1]]$gene
colnames(tum) <- tumor_ids
tum_vals <- marker_values(tum)

# ------------------------------ 4. TABLE -------------------------------------
tumor_ref <- data.frame(
  gene = rownames(tum_vals$cpm),
  tumor_median_cpm      = apply(tum_vals$cpm, 1, median),
  tumor_min_cpm         = apply(tum_vals$cpm, 1, min),
  tumor_max_cpm         = apply(tum_vals$cpm, 1, max),
  tumor_median_log2cpm  = apply(log2(tum_vals$cpm + 1), 1, median),
  row.names = NULL)

pdo_long <- bind_rows(lapply(colnames(pdo_vals$cpm), function(s) {
  data.frame(sample = s,
             gene = rownames(pdo_vals$cpm),
             raw_count = pdo_vals$counts[, s],
             cpm = pdo_vals$cpm[, s],
             log2cpm = log2(pdo_vals$cpm[, s] + 1),
             row.names = NULL)
}))

values <- pdo_long %>%
  left_join(markers, by = "gene") %>%
  left_join(tumor_ref, by = "gene") %>%
  mutate(fraction_of_tumor_median = round(cpm / tumor_median_cpm, 4)) %>%
  arrange(group, gene, sample)
write.csv(values, file.path(OUT_DIR, "PDO_marker_check_values.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(as_tibble(values %>% select(sample, gene, group, raw_count, cpm,
                                  tumor_median_cpm, fraction_of_tumor_median)),
      n = Inf)

# ------------------------------ 5. FIGURE ------------------------------------
tum_long <- as.data.frame(log2(tum_vals$cpm + 1)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "sample", values_to = "log2cpm") %>%
  left_join(markers, by = "gene")
pdo_plot <- pdo_long %>% left_join(markers, by = "gene")

pdo_cols <- setNames(c("#E41A1C", "#377EB8", "#4DAF4A", "#984EA3")[seq_len(ncol(pdo))],
                     colnames(pdo))

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_boxplot(data = tum_long, aes(gene, log2cpm), fill = "grey80",
               outlier.shape = NA, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_jitter(data = tum_long, aes(gene, log2cpm), width = 0.15, size = 0.8,
              colour = "grey40", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(data = pdo_plot, aes(gene, log2cpm, colour = sample),
             shape = 18, size = 4,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pdo_cols, name = "PDO") +
  facet_grid(~ group, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "log2(CPM + 1)",
       subtitle = "Grey: pILC tumors (contain immune and stromal cells). Diamonds: PDOs") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "plots", "PDO_marker_check.png"), p,
       width = 12, height = 5, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "plots", "PDO_marker_check.pdf"), p, width = 12, height = 5)

message("Done. Outputs in: ", OUT_DIR)
sessionInfo()
```
